title: Coalesced Memory Access
description: Threads in a warp should access contiguous memory so the hardware merges them into few transactions. Strided access multiplies transactions and tanks bandwidth. Coalescing is the first optimization every kernel gets.

demo.code:
print("warp accesses 32 contiguous floats -> 1 transaction")
print("warp accesses strided -> 32 transactions")
print("fix: transpose the layout")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Coalescing', 'target': 'Global memory', 'method': 'Contiguous warp access', 'gain': 'Up to 7x bandwidth', 'benefit': 'First optimization', 'complexity': 'Low'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'target', 'method', 'gain', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")

title: Shared Memory Tiling
description: Data is staged through shared memory in tiles so each global element is read once and reused many times. Tiling turns O(n^3) reads into O(n^3/tile). Matrix multiplication lives or dies by tiling.

demo.code:
TILE = 32
print("tile %dx%d in shared memory" % (TILE, TILE))
print("global reads per element: %d -> 1" % TILE)
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Tiling', 'target': 'Matmul', 'method': 'Shared-mem staging', 'gain': 'Near-peak FLOPS', 'benefit': 'Reuse maximized', 'complexity': 'Medium'}
print("technique:", _jah_schema["technique"])
assert set(_jah_schema) == set(['technique', 'target', 'method', 'gain', 'benefit', 'complexity']) and all(_jah_schema.values())
print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")

title: Bank Conflict Avoidance
description: Shared memory has 32 banks; threads hitting the same bank serialize. Padding arrays by one column removes the classic conflict. Bank conflicts are silent slowdowns.

demo.code:
print("__shared__ float tile[32][32];   // conflicts")
print("__shared__ float tile[32][33];   // padded, no conflicts")
_jah_schema = {'technique': 'Padding', 'target': 'Shared memory', 'method': 'Pad by 1', 'gain': 'Removes serialization', 'benefit': 'Silent fix', 'complexity': 'Medium'}

print("schema verified:", len(_jah_schema), "fields")
